review_text: Thanks to Flipkart for super fast delivery. The order was delivered to me in 13-14 hours which is very good! Now coming to the earbuds, The package/box has the following contents on unboxing :- 1. The earpods which is placed inside the case 2. Two pairs of extra ear tips to adjust according to your size and get the perfect fit 3. A USB-C charging cable 4. A boat sticker 5. Few paperwork like warranty card, FAQ, User Manual and others The case looks good and the earbuds are very light, comfortable and fits perfectly in the ears. I have used it continuously for 4-5 hrs at one go it doesn't cause any discomfort or pain to your ears. The earbuds are held in the case via magnets which are decent and strong. The case colour is too glossy and is prone to scratches and fingerprints (would have preferred it to be a bit less glossy as it'll really look scratched in a few days of normal use). The hinge is good no wobbles however it could have been a better better in quality howebe considering the price it's good. The sound if the earbuds is pretty good. Yes it won't beat your wired bassy earphones however it's very good indeed. Sound levels are good. It gives sound like a rupees 500-600 wired earphones. I don't think the sound could have been better at this budget. The mic is okay and acceptable. You won't face any issues while taking calls or attending meetings when you are indoors however outdoors it'll struggle (this is a problem of almost every earbud and is a limitation by design since the earbuds have mic placed far from your mouth unlike neckbands or other earphones where the mic is directly in front of you) There is no disconnection issue, the charging time of the earbuds from the case is around 30-35 mins and it gave me a backup of 4-5 hours at 50-60% sound levels. Overall I'll rate it 4.3* not a perfect 5 as I think the build quality, battery of the case and mic could have been a bit better. If I observe anything else will update the review. Certainly a good and one of the best buy in the price range from a trusted brand like boat with 1 year warranty!
